summary: Rackspace Technology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $250M in common stock via Goldman Sachs as sales agent. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices; no fixed price, premium, or tender is involved. The filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. There is no board recommendation, advisor retention, or structural change. The ATM program merely allows periodic sales into the market. No special-situation event is triggered.
